segments.title: July
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! July. The monsoon is here to test everyone's willpower. Our theme is Book the Studio plus Rain Check. We bring groups in together, make it easy to come back after the summer, and take the guilt out of rainy cancellations. The plan, thankfully, brought an umbrella.

segments.title: ₹2.09L
segments.text: So, the number. Our July target for Pop-up is 2.09 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent up on last July. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 92,100 rupees. That's 4 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 91,600, comebacks 23,600, and everything else 2,100. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 55 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 642 leads, 167 trials, and 55 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 1.19 lakh rupees, which is 57 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio
segments.text: First up, Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio. Book out the studio for up to twelve friends, your playlist, our instructor. Every first-timer in the room then gets three classes for the price of two. The plan is 2 buyers at about 10,000, so 20,000 rupees.
segments.notes: Anyone booking the studio for a private group of up to 12.

segments.title: The Second Date's On Us
segments.text: Next, for newcomers, The Second Date's On Us. First class at half price, the second one free, and the third? That's a relationship, with fifteen per cent off the first month and an extra freeze. The plan is 8 buyers at about 5,900, so 47,100 rupees.

segments.title: Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain. Fifteen per cent off to return, two extra freezes for flooded days, and a lane in The Amazing Race. The plan is 3 buyers at about 7,200, so 21,700 rupees.

segments.title: Rain Check (Literally)
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Rain Check, literally. Renew in July for ten per cent off and three Rain Check tokens, with classes credited back on red-alert days. Monsoon happens. Late-cancel fees don't have to. The plan is 4 buyers at about 7,700, so 30,600 rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, corporate and kitty party bookings open. Week two, we call everyone who left in the summer heat. Week three, the Rain Check renewal does the heavy lifting. Week four, returning members sign up for The Amazing Race.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's July at Pop-up. 2.09 lakh rupees, four offers, and 55 buyers to welcome. It's raining offers. Hallelujah.
